description: Aidatlar ve borclar: aidat aboneliklerini listeleme/detay/silme, borc (debt) olusturma, guncelleme, durum degistirme ve silme.

action.description: [update_debt_status] Zorunlu: update_debt_status. action to apply to the debt - remove: removes the debt - activate: activates the debt

add_payment.description: [create_debt] add the payment after adding the debt

added_by__name.description: [list, list_debts] User name (case-insensitive, unaccented) who added the payment. Used when added_by_id is not known.

added_by_id.description: [list, list_debts] User id who added the payment

amount.description: [create_debt, list, list_debts] debt amount ( also payment amount if custom amount is 'custom'.)

amt_cnd.description: [list, list_debts] amount condition if amount filter is present - null: equals to amount - !=: not equals to amount - <: smaller than amount - <=: smaller and equal to amount - \>: bigger than amount - \>=: bigger and equal to amount

create_date_cnd.description: [list, list_debts] Record creation date filter condition

custom_amount.description: [create_debt] amount for payment. total_debt for users total debt, custom for custom debt amount

debt_id.description: [delete_debt, get_debt, update_debt, update_debt_status] Zorunlu: delete_debt, get_debt, update_debt, update_debt_status.

end_date.description: [list] Zorunlu: list. End date filtering for transaction__complete_date or complete_date fields. Must be after start_date.

how_many.description: [list, list_debts] How many records should be listed

operation_date.description: [create_debt, list_debts, update_debt] Membership Due Operation Date

payment_method.description: [create_debt, list] payment type code - 0: Card - 1: Cash - 2: Wire Transfer - 3: POS - 4: SMS - 6: Postal Check - 7: Paypal - 8: BKM Express - 9: iDEAL - 10: Pay With Iyzico

payment_method_select.description: [create_debt] payment type selection. must be other for API

possible_duplicate.description: [list_debts] When true, returns only debts whose (user, period, amount) tuple appears more than once in the association's debts.

query.description: [list, list_debts] search parameter. start with - (minus) char to exclude searched text

remove_note.description: [update_debt] remove debt description for removed debt status

send_mail.description: [create_debt] send mail after adding the debt

start_date.description: [list] Zorunlu: list. Start date filtering for transaction__complete_date or complete_date fields. Must be before end_date.

status.description: [list, list_debts] what kind of membership dues should be listed - paid: for payments - refund: for refunds - failed: for failed payment transactions

thanks_mail_id.description: [create_debt] mail template to be sent after adding the debt

payment_method.description: payment type code - 0: Card - 1: Cash - 2: Wire Transfer - 3: POS - 4: SMS - 6: Postal Check - 7: Paypal - 8: BKM Express - 9: iDEAL - 10: Pay With Iyzico

transaction_id.description: bank transaction id / wire transfer query no
